nodes.label: Mission Control for AI Coding Sessions
nodes.rationale: Relay is positioned as a single interface for every AI model the user already pays for, avoiding third-party aggregation of conversations.
nodes.norm_label: mission control for ai coding sessions

nodes.label: Local Provider Credentials
nodes.rationale: Relay runs on the user's machine, talks directly to each provider using the user's own credentials, and keeps credentials and conversations local.

nodes.label: Smart Auto-routing
nodes.rationale: Auto mode chooses models by local availability, free provider login state, task type, and Anthropic context size so users can avoid manual provider selection while saving tokens.

nodes.label: Conversation Memory
nodes.rationale: Conversations keep lightweight memory and auto-summarize after 14+ messages to preserve coherent multi-turn context without spending tokens on stale messages.

nodes.label: Streaming Provider Pattern
nodes.rationale: All providers implement a common streaming pattern where stream*Message() emits chat-chunk IPC events assembled by the renderer, making new providers a repeatable addition.
